profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company, listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ZS (CIK 0001713683), that describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation. Its core offering is the Zero Trust Exchange platform, which the company describes as leveraging the largest security cloud on the planet to anticipate, secure, and simplify business operations for large enterprises. The site also emphasizes a unified, zero-trust framework for tracing data lineage and governing agent-to-agent interactions, positioning this capability as central to compliance and competitive advantage.

The company's AI product, tracked on this site as Zscaler AI, encompasses cloud security AI, a Security Service Edge platform, data loss prevention, and AI traffic inspection. Zscaler maintains an ecosystem of partners and integrations that it says enables faster deployments and more agile operations for customers. No litigation, MCP servers, or SEC filings beyond the basic public-company registration appear in the held facts for this entry.
